subject: Procurement path & marketplace readiness — Borealis evaluation
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Cho <leah@borealis.ai>, ProcureOps Team <procureops@borealis.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-05T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement path & marketplace readiness — Borealis evaluation

Hi Leah / ProcureOps,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to hear where you are on the POC and the high-level use cases. Quick follow-up to confirm procurement preferences so we can line up the right ops and legal resources:

- Preferred commercial path for pilot and initial purchase: (A) AWS Marketplace (Private Offer) — finance likes speed of procurement, but legal often wants to review terms first, or (B) PO / Invoice through standard vendor onboarding, or (C) Corporate card for a short paid POC. Which do you prefer?
- Do you need a Redwood-signed MSA before pilot, or is a Marketplace Private Offer sufficient to start?
- Any specific billing contacts / AP email that we should copy?
- Your legal team’s review turnaround — typical SLA for redlines?

Attached: procurement_requirements.pdf (your procurement intake we discussed) and SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf for your security team. I’ve cc’d Marissa to help with any commercial flexibility.

Next steps I propose: if you confirm marketplace preference, we can initiate marketplace enablement with our enablement team and surface a Private Offer draft for legal. If you prefer PO/invoice, Monica (cc’d on follow-up) will scope billing terms and payment terms.

Would love a short reply w/ preferred path and timeline (e.g., \"Marketplace + legal review ~2 weeks\").

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Leah Cho <leah@borealis.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps Team <procureops@borealis.ai>
Date: 2026-09-05T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement path & marketplace readiness — Borealis evaluation

Hi Diego — thanks for the clear recap.

Quick answers from ProcureOps:
- Preference for speed: AWS Marketplace private offer is preferred for pilot (finance can approve faster).
- Legal: they will want to review any Private Offer language; likely a 7–14 business day turnaround for standard redlines, slower for bespoke clauses.
- Billing contact: ap@borealis.ai (please send any invoice/PO requests there).
- We do need SOC2 evidence — thanks for sending the snapshot. We may request the full report under NDA if we move to contract.

I’ve attached our procurement_requirements.pdf (filled) — it includes our internal PO process and who needs to sign. Let me know if you need anything else from our side to start the Private Offer flow.

Best,
Leah
Leah Cho
Sr. Procurement Manager | Borealis AI

--
Attachment: procurement_requirements.pdf (see form)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-06T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Procurement path & marketplace readiness — Borealis evaluation

Marissa / Karthik / Monica,

Fwd’ing Borealis’ reply — they prefer AWS Marketplace Private Offer for the pilot but legal will want to review. AP contact is ap@borealis.ai. They may request a full SOC2 under NDA once we advance.

Action items:
- Karthik: can you confirm our Private Offer flow timeline and whether we can pre-seed the PO terms for faster legal review? Any special clauses to flag?
- Monica: if Marketplace turns out to be slow or they ask for PO/invoice, can you draft a short-term card-based POC option and sample invoice terms we can send them?
- Marissa: recommend we offer a 30-day paid POC via marketplace (Private Offer) + fallback to card with credits if legal stalls — your call on commercial concession.

I’ll coordinate a short sync with their procurement if needed.

Thanks,
Diego

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-06T10:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Procurement path & marketplace readiness — Borealis evaluation

Diego / team — quick notes from marketplace ops:
- Private Offer timeline: we can create a draft Private Offer and governance docs within 48–72 hours once we have the procurement intake and billing entity (they provided ap@borealis.ai).
- Legal gotchas: watch for indemnity and data residency clauses — if Borealis asks for custom language we should route to Legal; that can add 1–2 weeks.
- SOC2: we can provide the standard SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf; for a full report we’ll request an NDA (we have a template we can push).
- Payment fallbacks: recommend offering card-first for a <$15k POC, Marketplace Private Offer for mid-sized pilots, and PO/invoice only if AP requires it for long-term commitments.

I’ll draft the Private Offer skeleton and share internally. Monica — please prepare a one-page card-PO fallback option (billing terms, refund/credits).

Karthik
Head of Marketplace Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Cho <leah@borealis.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ProcureOps Team <procureops@borealis.ai>
Date: 2026-09-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement path & marketplace readiness — Borealis evaluation

Thanks Leah — appreciate the clarity. Quick summary & proposed next steps: 

1) Redwood will initiate AWS Marketplace private offer draft once we receive the completed procurement intake (we received your form). Karthik’s team will produce the skeleton PO within 48–72 hours.
2) Borealis legal review expected 7–14 business days; if you expect longer, flag us and we’ll offer a provisional card-based pilot so you can start evaluation without delay. Monica to send card/PO fallback terms within 24 hours.
3) If Borealis needs the full SOC2, we’ll provide it under NDA — I can send our NDA template today.
4) Next sync: optional 20-min call Tuesday to walk the Private Offer flow with your ProcureOps + our Marketplace Ops + Legal (propose Tue 2026-09-09 09:30 PT). Please confirm availability.

DocuSign link for a short mutual NDA (if helpful): https://www.docusign.com/containers/embeddedSigning?envelopeId=abc123xyz

If that plan works I’ll trigger the marketplace enablement and loop in our enablement engineer. Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot started.

Best,
Diego
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
